label: LSM303 Tilt-Compensated Electronic Compass
info: Tilt-compensated electronic compass demo for the LSM303DLHC e-compass module. An inject node triggers the periph-lsm303 node once a second; each message carries the 3-axis acceleration (g), the 3-axis magnetic flux density (µT), the tilt-compensated heading (degrees, 0–360), and the relative temperature (°C). A function node formats the heading as a 16-point compass name (N, NNE, NE, …) and derives pitch and roll from the acceleration vector. A debug node shows the values. Rotate and tilt the board: the compass name tracks magnetic north in the horizontal plane while pitch / roll show the board's attitude. Adjust the accelerometer range (±2/±4/±8/±16 g), accelerometer data rate (1 Hz – 5.376 kHz), magnetometer range (±130 – ±810 µT) and magnetometer data rate (0.75 – 220 Hz) in the node configuration to match the application; both I²C addresses (0x19 and 0x1E) are fixed by the module.

name: heading name + pitch/roll
